test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four-segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

They attend / a meeting / in Chicago / this weekend.
solution:
The correct answer is **"they attend"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Error is in the part **"they attend"** of the sentence.
 
• As per the sentence structure, they must attend it this weekend.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should be in the Future Continuous tense. Its correct form will be:
 
 
• ***They will be attending** a meeting in Chicago this weekend.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points correct answer is **option 4** **"they attend"**.

 

The correct answer: *They will be attending a meeting in Chicago this weekend.*
